mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Force Pulse (@Stack@)</titleLeft><mainText>After 6 spells are cast near Kassadin, he can cast Force Pulse.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity (1800 range), gaining a charge whenever a spell is cast near him. Upon reaching 6 charges, Kassadin can use <spellName>Force Pulse</spellName> to deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> enemies by @MoveSpeedMod*-100@% for 3 seconds in a cone in front of him.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kassadin gains bonus <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed>  equal to 15% of <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> taken.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Null Sphere</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has a shield that absorbs magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kassadin fires an ethereal bolt of void energy, dealing damage and silencing the target for a duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kassadin fires a void bolt, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Silencing</status> the target for @SilenceDuration@ second(s).

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Riftwalk (@Stack@)</titleLeft><mainText>Kassadin's next Riftwalk will cost more Mana and deal additional damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Additionally, multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana and deal additional damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to surrounding enemy units. Additionally, each subsequent <spellName>Riftwalk</spellName> within the next 8 seconds costs <scaleMana>100 additional Mana</scaleMana> and deals <magicDamage>@Damage@ additional damage</magicDamage>, stacks up to 10 times.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Nether Blade</titleLeft><mainText>Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks restore Mana. The Mana restored is tripled against enemy champions. Active: Kassadin's basic attacks deal additional magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks draw energy from the void, restoring @ManaGainAmount@ Mana each hit. If the target is an enemy champion, the Mana restored is tripled to @ManaGainAmount*3@.

Active: Kassadin charges his nether blade for 5 seconds causing his basic attacks to deal an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage.
